prompt: Halfway down a textbook page you realise your mind wandered and you remember nothing of it. What is the most helpful response?

options.text: Give up on reading for the rest of the day
Start the page again and read it faster, to finish sooner
Pause, note in a few words what distracted you, then re-read the page in smaller sections, checking you understand each one
Highlight the whole page so it counts as studied

explanation: Noting the distraction clears it from your mind, and reading in smaller sections with quick understanding checks catches wandering early instead of at the end of another lost page.
